notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign Launched!
notes.content:
The Kickstarter campaign begins!
The campaign provides a way for future players to influence the development of the game while providing support to the developer. 
Campaign Details
Support the campaign here to receive exclusive, time-limited rewards!

Duration: Sept 3rd - Oct 3rd

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659602/f998c06dc05d03f50ef0ee05dfb43b33354eabd7.png"]
Rewards
Rewards include, but not limited to:

Special Thanks in Credits

Vinyl Stickers

Custom NPC

Custom Game Ending

Custom Tinket

Digital Wallpapers

Soundtrack

... and more!



Thank you for all your continued support!

Your generosity realizes my dream!
